scope: Read-only inspection of deployed immutable GTFS and active OTP graph; no paid provider calls.

geometry_variant_sample.selection: First 50 directed consecutive stop pairs encountered in stop_times with different full-trip shape_id values. Up to three shapes retained per selected pair; first two compared.
method: Read trips metadata and consecutive stop_times rows grouped by trip_id; use increasing stop_sequence.
For a pair, retain full shape_id plus from/to shape_dist_traveled; different full shape_id is only a candidate for comparison.
Read only needed shapes and order by shape_pt_sequence.
Clip each shape between the stop_times distance values by linear interpolation in shape_dist_traveled; omit zero-distance shape segments.
For approximate metre measurements project longitude by 55660 and latitude by 111320; this is a local approximation near latitude 60 degrees.
Compare maximum bidirectional vertex-to-polyline distance for the two clipped geometries; also calculate clipped lengths and endpoint gaps.
Skip comparisons with fewer than two clipped coordinates; the number skipped was not logged.
geometry_variant_sample.conclusion: No convincing example of different physical roads between the same stop pair was established in this limited sample. Do not mandate a multigraph based only on differing full shape_ids.
limitations: Not an exhaustive or random sample.
Rounding of shape_dist_traveled and geometric data can cause small discrepancies.
No manual map validation was performed.
All individual comparisons were not retained; largest results and aggregate printed statistics are recorded here.

active_graph_retention.interpretation: Inputs are not guaranteed to remain available with the graph. Surface snapshot currently matches latest and remains available; original metro snapshot is already absent from the store. Retention observations are a point-in-time state, not immutable metadata.

probe_pair_adjacency_check.reason: The temporary remote full-scan dictionary was not retained. No extra scan of 3553379 stop_times rows was performed for this check. Nearest-neighbour probe selection is not evidence of GTFS adjacency.

minimal_model_proposal.ambiguity_policy: If incompatible between-stop trajectories are actually found, do not combine observations; record ambiguity and discuss whether explicit geometry variants are required.

surface_frequencies.interpretation: All frequency records declare headway-based service without an exact timetable (exact_times=0). The same trip_id in such a record is a frequency service template, not evidence of one specific physical departure. Do not describe a next bus inferred only from this data as an exact scheduled departure.
surface_frequencies.limits: This inspection did not inspect all stop_times again, calculate the total trip count, or prove the cause of OTP repeated alternatives. Read only frequencies.txt plus trips/routes metadata.
